info.cls_ename: Applied Second Foreign Language Elective Courses

description.describe_ch: 越南文(一)適合沒有學過越南語的初學者，旨在提供基本越南語發音、基礎詞彙和語法結構的訓練，並著重於口語能力和聽力技巧。本課程包括5堂發音和7堂會話課程。所有主題皆會提供必備單字，幫助學習者能夠使用越南語跟越南人交談。每堂課會藉由視覺教具來模擬會話內容。修習完本課程後，學生應能用越南語介紹自己及談論自身興趣和活動。
description.describe_eh: Vietnamese (1) is for learners who have never learned the Vietnamese language. This level offers training in basic Vietnamese pronunciation with elementary vocabulary and grammatical structures and is strongly focused on speaking and listening skills. Vietnamese (1) includes five lessons in pronunciation and seven in conversation. Necessary vocabulary items are provided for all topics to help learners converse in Vietnamese with Vietnamese speakers. Classroom conversations are simulated with visual aids. After finishing Vietnamese (1), the students should be able to use Vietnamese to introduce themselves and talk about general interests and activities.
